data.name: Demo
data.body:
Sample cards in every status so the UI can be checked without real work.
Paused: the worker never touches it.

data.title: Pick a logo
data.goal: Decide on a wordmark vs an icon for the demo app.
data.question: Wordmark only, icon only, or both? No acceptance criteria yet, so this stays in backlog.

data.title: Add health endpoint
data.goal: GET /health returns 200 and the git sha so uptime checks have something to hit.

data.title: Paginate the users list
data.goal: Users list loads 50k rows at once. Add cursor pagination, 50 per page.

acceptance.text: Test for last page returns empty `next`

data.title: Choose auth library
data.goal: Login needs JWT issuing and verification. Pick the library and wire a login endpoint.

acceptance.text: POST /login returns a JWT for valid credentials
401 on bad credentials, both covered by tests

data.question:
Which JWT library? The repo has none installed and project.md does not say.
- A) `jose` (recommended) — zero deps, maintained, Web Crypto based
- B) `jsonwebtoken` — most common, older API
- C) Hand-roll HS256 with node:crypto — no dependency, ~40 lines
If unanswered, the card waits. Nothing was changed in the repo.

data.title: Delete stale sessions nightly
data.goal: Sessions table grows forever. Add a nightly job that removes rows older than N days.

acceptance.text: Job runs from the existing cron runner
Old rows removed, recent rows kept, covered by a test

data.question:
How old is stale? This deletes data, so I did not guess.
- A) 30 days (recommended) — matches the refresh-token lifetime in config
- B) 7 days
- C) 90 days
The job is written with a `STALE_DAYS` constant; only the value is missing.

data.title: Fix flaky date test
data.goal: `formatRelative` test fails around midnight because it uses the real clock.
data.result:
Changed `src/time.js` to accept `now` as a parameter (default `Date.now`), and
`test/time.test.js` passes `new Date('2026-01-01T23:59:59')`.
Verify: `npm test` on branch `card-006-fix-flaky-date-test`; ran it 20x in a loop, all green.
Nothing else touched.

data.title: Set up ESLint
data.goal: Flat config ESLint with the recommended rules.
data.result: Added `eslint.config.js`, `lint` script, and a lint step in `ci.yml`.

data.name: Workbench
data.body:
The board app itself. Node 22 stdlib only, vanilla front end, no build step.
Run: `node app/server.mjs` then open http://localhost:4242.
Tests: `node --test`.
Conventions: ES modules, no dependencies, load-bearing comments only.
